edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber I 18

source_text: Historica species: sponsa ecclesiae vel animae orat ut Verbum praesens oscula doctrinae tribuat; melius esse dicit ubera gratiae vino litterae; nomen Christi unguentum diffusum adulescentulas colligit; tracta currunt; in cellaria mysteriorum introducuntur; aequitas tandem perfecte diligit. Haec historiae linea Libri Primi.
pass_a_gloss: Historical appearance: bride of-church or of-soul prays that Word present kisses of-teaching may-grant; better to-be she-says breasts of-grace than-wine of-letter...
pass_b_english: The historical shape: the Bride — church or soul — prays that the Word present give kisses of teaching; she says the breasts of grace are better than the wine of the letter; Christ’s name, ointment poured out, gathers the young women; drawn, they run; they are brought into the chambers of the mysteries; at last equity loves perfectly. This is the historical line of the First Book.
